notes: The release chain's stages in order, read by scripts/ci/release-watch.ts (cloud #264). Each stage runs from one event to the next, so the stages are contiguous and the hand-off gaps count in the stage they lead into.

Events: merged (the oldest public PR merged into the release), published (the public release), pin_opened (the pin-bump/<tag> PR opened), pinned (the pin commit on cloud main: the PR's merge, or the direct pin commit), then <step>.started and <step>.done for the runs of hosted_release, staging_publish, staging_deploy, redline, prod_publish and prod_deploy.
mode pr stages count only for a release pinned through a pin-bump PR, mode direct only for one pinned by a direct commit on main. pinMode is the mode a release with neither yet is waiting in.

usual is each stage's median in minutes over every measured release below where that stage finished green (a red stage is not counted). They are the 22 public releases v0.235.2 to v0.248.1, read by a read-only backfill tick (release-watch.ts tick --since 2026-11-20 --no-issue) at 2026-11-26T03:41Z. n per stage: tag 22, pin_open 17, pin_merge 15, hosted_release 13, staging_publish 12, staging_deploy 12, redline_queue 12, redline 7, prod_publish 7, prod_deploy 7.

direct_pin has no measured release yet: its usual 2.1 is an estimate, pin_open's median, since the same pin-bump run makes the pin commit instead of opening the PR. Measure it once releases pin directly.

The alert: one blocker issue while any stage of a release in flight, or of the newest finished release, runs past alertFactor x its usual time (in progress or finished). e2eTarget is merge to every install in minutes (to the prod deploy until fleet is measured): every release's total is reported against it in the summary, never alerted on.

fleet is not measured yet: it needs a public fleet done signal (the scheduler's fleet_done mark served at GET /api/v1/fleet on the signup hosts, Lane 5 PR2). The watcher never reads fleet state through admin tools.
